name: album-cover-director
description: Explore bold, meaning-led cover concepts in labeled thumbnail boards, then finish selected image-native title designs.

interface.shortDescription: Explore bold cover ideas, then finish your choice.
interface.longDescription: Reads an exact release title with optional lyrics, song and album context, artist information, and reference images; explores distinct visual mechanisms in a labeled thumbnail board; preserves the selected concept through image-native production and 3000 px delivery.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $album-cover-director to explore twelve bold, structurally different cover ideas from this title and any optional lyrics, album context, artist information, or reference images. Show a labeled thumbnail board, then finish the selected concept.
